//: An editor opening a file here needs a project to resolve it against; without one it falls back to defaults and reports errors that no gate does. This is that project. It is not part of `check.sh`, which type-checks the *source* and the host provider through `tooling/conformance/web-platform/tsconfig.json`; nothing here is emitted. **This one is laxer than the one that judges, so do not develop against it.** It sets `noUnusedLocals` and `noUnusedParameters` false, because a half-written test legitimately has both, and the conformance project does not. A refactor that leaves an import behind passes here and fails the gate at its first step -- which happened, and cost a full gate run to find something the strict project reports in seconds. Run `tsc -p tooling/conformance/web-platform/tsconfig.json --noEmit` before believing a change to `src/` is clean; this project answers a different question, which is whether an editor can resolve the file in front of you.
